description: Seven separate attenuators, each with its own input, knob and output, and no connection between them

params.text: Scales the signal on that row, passing nothing fully anticlockwise and the whole input fully clockwise

inputs.text: The signal the knob on that row scales

outputs.text: The input on that row multiplied by the knob on that row

notes: every knob comes up fully anticlockwise, so all seven outputs are at 0V until one is raised.
